PharmaGuard 2.0

Keep medicines moving when the supply chain breaks.

When a flood closes a distribution hub, medicines get stuck. PharmaGuard helps an operations team report the disruption, see which shipments are affected, and approve a recovery plan from one screen.

What makes it different

A person decides

The manager approves, modifies or rejects every plan before anything runs.

Agents do the legwork

Separate agents sense the disruption, plan options, reroute and rebalance stock.

Nothing gets lost

Each SOS report is stored with an ID, location, category, severity, time and status.

Where it can be used

  • Pharmaceutical manufacturing and distribution
  • Medicine transport and logistics
  • Time-sensitive medicine monitoring
  • Incident review and escalation
  • Inventory and alternate-route planning

PharmaGuard 2.0 is a working prototype shown running on a local computer. It does not yet connect to live data feeds or real emergency services.
